market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool is a perennial top-4 contender with a strong squad and new manager Arne Slot entering his second season, plus expected investment. They finished in the top 4 in 5 of the last 6 seasons and narrowly missed once. The market's 52.5% implied probability significantly undervalues their consistency and resources, suggesting a real probability nearer 70%.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished top-4 in 5 of the 6 most recent completed EPL seasons, missing only in 2022-23 (5th by 4 points).
Club infrastructure, wage bill, and transfer budget remain top-tier, sustaining a deep and competitive squad.
Arne Slot will have had a full season to implement his system, with young talent (e.g., Szoboszlai, Núñez) still improving.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Liverpool's squad and strategic stability
